children: Yields on U.K. government bonds, or gilts, drop as oil prices edge lower after President Trump announced a deal with Russia to supply diesel. Nonetheless, gilt yields remain close to the multi-decade highs reached last week as inflation concerns and fiscal jitters weigh on investor sentiment. Ten-year gilt yields fall 3.9 basis points to last trade at 5.417%, having hit a 19-year high of 5.527% last week, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
